function.name: retrieve_node
function.description: Purpose: inspect one node before planning edits. Returns all stored metadata for a file or folder.

node_id.description: Exact identifier (code or UUID) of the node to fetch.

function.name: create_node
function.description: Purpose: create a new folder or file node. Use this only for creation, not editing existing files. If the tree is empty this call can also create the root (use code "ROOT").

parent_id.description: Identifier of the parent folder (containig the new node). Use "ROOT" to attach to (or create) the root.

name.description: File or folder name as it will appear on disk (e.g. "main.py", "utils").

description.description: Short human-readable description of the node’s purpose. If node has empty 'code' specify that into description.

language.description: Programming language or file type (e.g. "python", "typescript"). Leave null for folders or non-code assets.

commit_message.description: Suggested commit message for VCS operations involving this node.

code.description: When is_file is true, the actual code of the file to be executed in the programming language specified.

function.name: update_node
function.description: Purpose: metadata or tree-structure updates only (rename, description, scope, language, commit message, move). This tool does not edit file code/content.

node_id.description: Identifier of the node to modify.

new_name.description: New file name (omit to keep the same).

description.description: Updated description (omit to keep the same).  If node has empty 'code' specify that into description.

scope.description: Updated functional scope (omit to keep the same).

language.description: Updated programming language (omit to keep the same).

commit_message.description: Updated commit message. Always update commit message.

new_parent_id.description: Identifier of the new parent folder (omit to keep the same parent).

function.name: delete_node
function.description: Purpose: delete a node from the project tree. Use cascade for subtree deletion, or promote_children to keep descendants.

node_id.description: Identifier of the node to delete.

cascade.description: If true, delete this node and its entire subtree.

promote_children.description: If *cascade* is false and this is true, children are re-attached to the deleted node’s parent.

function.name: run_terminal_commands
function.description: Run a single or multiple terminal commands in the project workspace. Use for read-only inspection (ls/cat/grep/git status), linting, or quick checks. Destructive commands may be blocked by safe_mode. You will be running these commands from the root of the project: be careful in navigating the directories beforehand.

shell.description: Shell to use. Prefer 'bash' on Linux/macOS, 'pwsh' on Windows if available.

command.description: Exact command to run. Provide a single shell string or an argv array.

timeout.description: Max seconds to wait before timing out. Default 90.

workdir.description: Optional subdirectory relative to the project root.

check.description: If true, raise on non-zero exit before returning (default false).

env.description: Extra environment variables to merge (string key/values).
